statement.description: One INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE, or CREATE, ALTER or DROP of a TABLE, INDEX, TYPE or MATERIALIZED VIEW. IF NOT EXISTS, IF EXISTS and IF conditions make a lightweight transaction. No BATCH. A person approves the exact statement.

values.description: Values of the markers: an array for ?, in order, or an object for :name, typed as for cassandra_query.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
